item.title: Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows Bitcoin’s Lightning Network topped $1.17 billion in November monthly volume across 5.22 million transactions, according to River Financial, which says the milestone reflects growing adoption despite flat price action. This post Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: Bitcoin’s 50% Slide: Quantum Scare or Capital Rotation?
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s 50% Slide: Quantum Scare or Capital Rotation? Bitcoin’s massive slide from its October high near $126,000 to about $67,000 has sparked debate over whether fears of quantum computing pose a real threat to the network’s cryptography or whether the downturn is better explained by shifting capital flows. This post Bitcoin’s 50% Slide: Quantum Scare or Capital Rotation? first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
